description: Fix the layout of the real estate flyer at /home/ga/Documents/draft_flyer.odt. The document currently has images that are floating incorrectly or pushing text out of place. You must: (1) Rename the top logo image object to 'Company_Logo' and anchor it 'To Page' in the top-right corner with 'Wrap Through' or 'None'. (2) Rename the large house photo object to 'House_Photo', anchor it 'To Paragraph' (to the first body paragraph), and set text wrapping to 'Parallel' (or Optimal) so text flows around it. (3) Rename the signature image at the bottom to 'Agent_Signature' and anchor it 'As Character' so it sits inline with the text. (4) Apply 'Heading 1' style to the document title line. Save the corrected file as /home/ga/Documents/final_flyer.odt.
